dkim_socket.description: Socket specification for milter communication with the MTA (e.g., inet:port[@address] or local:/path/to/socket).

dkim_pid_file.description: Path to write the process PID file.

dkim_user.description: User (and optionally group) to run the service as.

dkim_domain.description: Domain(s) to sign for. Multiple domains can be space-separated. Uncomment to enable.

dkim_key_file.description: Path to the private key file used for signing.

dkim_selector.description: DKIM selector used in the DNS TXT record (e.g., selector._domainkey.example.com).
